D_parameters: 5-6M unregistered smallholder farms; deforestation pressure; child labor risk; climate stress; monoculture soil degradation
C_parameters: Cooperative extension services; CLMRS enrollment; shade-tree programs; certification scheme training
notes: Geolocation polygon data for EUDR compliance is the key missing data element. ICCO provides aggregate national production figures but farm-level data is sparse.

physical_state_in: Wet unfermented cocoa beans in pod pulp
physical_state_out: Dry fermented cocoa beans in jute sacks
primary_transformation: Biochemical lactic/acetic fermentation then solar drying
measurable_output: Dry bean moisture content and bean count grade
D_parameters: No standard process; no temperature monitoring; no chain-of-custody; no identity preservation; child labor concentrated here; highly variable quality
C_parameters: Artisanal knowledge; some cooperative training; fermentation box programs; Rainforest Alliance good-practice guidelines
notes: This is the chain's structural bottleneck. No systematic data exists at farm level. Quality grading happens downstream at LBC/export stage. Sustainability certifications issued at cooperative membership level cannot verify practices at this phase.

physical_state_in: Dry beans in village storage or cooperative warehouses
physical_state_out: Graded and weighed export-ready beans at regional depot
primary_transformation: Commercial aggregation grading and transport to depot
measurable_output: Certified export-grade beans by weight and quality class
D_parameters: Multiple intermediary layers; variable moisture testing; price opacity between LBCs; informal market parallel to CCC system
C_parameters: CCC minimum farm-gate price guarantee (Ivory Coast); COCOBOD monopsony (Ghana); LBC license system; cooperative aggregation infrastructure; weighbridge certification
notes: CCC and COCOBOD provide institutional price floors. LBC counts and licensed volumes are published. Quality grading at depot level is documented.

physical_state_in: Graded beans at major port warehouse
physical_state_out: Exported beans in containers OR cocoa liquor/butter/powder
primary_transformation: Port export documentation OR origin industrial grinding
D_parameters: Split flow: 65% export vs 35% origin grinding introduces complexity; port congestion; forward sales scheduling by CCC
C_parameters: Port infrastructure (Abidjan San Pedro Tema); CCC export registration; ADM/Cargill/Olam/Barry Callebaut origin processing plants; CIF export contracts
notes: CCC and port authority publish export data. Origin grinding volumes reported by ICCO and major processors. Ivory Coast strategic goal: 50% domestic processing by 2030.

physical_state_in: Bagged beans in containers or isotank semi-finished
primary_transformation: Maritime bulk transport with temperature/humidity control
measurable_output: Bill of lading documented weight and grade
D_parameters: Shipping rate volatility; Red Sea disruptions (2024); temperature/humidity management risk; container availability
C_parameters: Bill of lading system; INCOTERMS; Rotterdam/Amsterdam port infrastructure; weight manifests; phytosanitary certificates
notes: Maritime phase has the highest transparency in the chain. Port arrival data published. Bill-of-lading weight is the primary custody anchor.

physical_state_in: Cocoa beans at destination port or semi-finished in storage
physical_state_out: Cocoa liquor + cocoa butter + cocoa powder
primary_transformation: Industrial roasting cracking winnowing grinding and pressing
measurable_output: Cocoa products by weight and type
D_parameters: Oligopoly concentration (3 firms >60% global capacity); EU regulatory complexity; EUDR compliance due diligence requirements; cadmium/lead contamination risk
C_parameters: World-class Amsterdam grinding infrastructure; EU food safety standards (EC 1881/2006); company traceability systems (BC Cocoa Horizons / Cargill Cocoa Promise / Olam AtSource); EU EUDR framework
notes: Major processors publish grinding volumes. ICCO tracks destination grinding by country. EU regulatory compliance is well-documented.

physical_state_in: Cocoa butter + liquor + powder + other inputs
physical_state_out: Finished chocolate confectionery and cocoa-based products
primary_transformation: Chocolate tempering conching and packaging plus brand marketing
typical_time_scale: Weeks to months per production run
measurable_output: Retail product units sold and market value
D_parameters: Retail oligopoly (supermarket chains >50% shelf); brand capture (farm-gate:retail ratio ~1:6); packaging waste; sustainability premium not reaching farmers; Fairtrade premium only USD 200/mt
C_parameters: Consumer demand for certified products; Fairtrade/RA/UTZ labels; manufacturer sustainability commitments; Mars/Nestle/Mondelez sourcing policies
notes: Aggregate retail market data available (Euromonitor). Farm-to-retail premium transmission is documented by Fairtrade International. Company-specific cost structures are private.
